content:
Delivering High-Impact OOH Campaigns Across Industrial, Transit, and International Touchpoints

At the heart of every successful out-of-home campaign is a simple principle: place the brand where its audience naturally moves, dwells, and pays attention. Across three recent deployments — spanning a leading industrial corridor in Pune, premium metro stations in Mumbai, and an international airport in the United States — we have demonstrated how strategic media selection, location intelligence, and end-to-end execution can transform everyday commuter environments into powerful brand-building platforms.

Strategic Hoarding Placement at Bhosari MIDC, Pune

The first engagement focused on building sustained brand visibility for a client targeting industrial decision-makers and corporate commuters in one of Pune's most active manufacturing hubs. The objective was clear: ensure consistent exposure to professionals, business owners, and logistics traffic moving daily through this critical industrial corridor.

Bhosari MIDC is a dense industrial belt that sees heavy traffic from manufacturing companies, suppliers, transport fleets, and corporate workforces throughout the day. To capitalise on this movement, we secured a high-visibility roadside hoarding on the main approach road to the MIDC, placing the brand directly in the line of sight of industrial commuters, corporate professionals, logistics and transport operators, and daily office traffic. The placement was chosen specifically to capture maximum attention during peak-hour movement, converting routine commute time into repeated, high-quality brand exposure for a highly targeted B2B audience.

Metro Station Co-Branding for State Bank of India

Our second engagement involved a large-scale co-branding partnership with the State Bank of India, designed to reinforce the bank's market leadership and strengthen brand visibility across Mumbai's busiest metro stations. SBI sought an immersive, premium presence that would engage daily commuters throughout their entire transit journey, not simply at a single touchpoint.

The co-branding programme was executed across three strategic stations — Vidhan Bhavan Metro Station, CSMIA T2 Metro Station, and Dadar Metro Station — covering a combined area of more than 10,000 square feet. We delivered end-to-end station branding as part of the co-branding rights, transforming each location into a high-impact brand environment. The scope included station-wide vinyl branding, lit box displays, digital pods and video walls, wall and pillar branding, and a range of high-visibility commuter touchpoints. Every creative installation was designed and executed to maintain a consistent brand identity across multiple interaction zones, ensuring SBI remained top-of-mind from the moment a commuter entered the station to the point of exit.

International Airport Media Deployment at Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport

The third engagement took the brand onto the global stage with a large-format media deployment at Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport in the United States. The client sought to establish a strong presence at a major international airport to reach high-value travellers, business professionals, and international passengers within a premium travel environment where brand recall is especially powerful.

Detroit Metropolitan was selected for its high passenger traffic and its strong mix of domestic and international business travellers, making it an ideal setting for premium exposure. We deployed 30 high-impact video walls across key passenger movement zones, with strategic placement at arrivals, passenger walkways, waiting areas, high-footfall transit corridors, and key dwell-time zones. The deployment generated strong impression volumes and premium audience engagement, positioning the brand in front of travellers during the most attention-rich moments of their journey and reinforcing recall within an aspirational, globally connected environment.

The Common Thread

Although these three campaigns differ significantly in format, geography, and audience profile, they share a common foundation: precise location selection, media formats matched to commuter behaviour, and execution designed for consistency and impact. Whether reaching industrial decision-makers on a Pune approach road, engaging lakhs of Mumbai commuters across premium metro environments, or placing an Indian brand in front of international business travellers in the United States, each deployment reflects our core capability — turning the right environments into measurable brand outcomes through thoughtful, end-to-end out-of-home execution.
result: These three deployments delivered strong brand visibility, high-quality audience engagement, and consistent recall across highly targeted industrial, transit, and international environments. Each campaign successfully converted high-footfall commuter zones into measurable brand-building opportunities, reinforcing client presence among decision-makers, daily commuters, and premium travellers alike.

title: New India Assurance – Head Office

content:

title: Cosmos × IMTEX 2025
summary: L-shaped anamorphic LED screen brought engineering to life in 3D.
excerpt: L-shaped anamorphic LED screen brought precision engineering to life in stunning 3D at India's largest machine tools exhibition.
content:
At India's premier manufacturing exhibition, IMTEX 2025, we deployed a custom-designed L-shaped anamorphic LED screen that brought engineering to life in three dimensions.

The immersive visuals were designed to spotlight Cosmos's four newly launched machines, blending high-impact content with illusion-based creativity.

The result? A nonstop crowd, hundreds of phones recording, and a perfect harmony of technology and storytelling.

title: Ajanta Pharma × Yashobhoomi
summary: Immersive 3D illusion campaign turning heads at a pharma summit.
excerpt: Immersive 3D illusion campaign turning heads and capturing premium mindshare at a national pharma summit in Delhi.
content:
For pharmaceutical giant Ajanta Pharma, innovation isn't limited to the lab — it extends to how they communicate their story.

At a high-profile event held at Yashobhoomi, Delhi, we conceptualized and delivered an anamorphic video experience that turned heads and sparked conversations.

It was a seamless blend of science, design, and digital magic.

title: NBC Bearings × Multi-Vehicle Showcase
summary: Cross-industry 3D narrative showcasing bearings in motion.
excerpt: Cross-industry 3D narrative showcasing ball bearings in motion across automotive, industrial, and rail applications.
content:
NBC Bearings approached us with a unique challenge: showcase the versatility of their products across multiple industries — all in one visual experience.

We responded with a custom anamorphic video that placed NBC's bearings at the heart of motion across cars, bikes, trucks, and more.

The visual narrative peeled back the layers of each vehicle to reveal the bearings in action.

title: Bank of India × Tata Marathon
summary: Emotive corporate film captured during India's biggest marathon.
excerpt: Emotive corporate film captured during India's biggest marathon — showcasing the bank's commitment to community and endurance.
content:
At the Tata Mumbai Marathon 2025, we captured a powerful corporate film that followed BOI employees as they ran for health, unity, and brand spirit.

The result was more than just a shoot — it was a moving, motivational story of resilience and corporate pride.

Every frame was a statement: that real brands are built by real people who go the extra mile.

title: Solution One ERP × Pin-Code Targeting
summary: Precision media in Pune's Bhosari industrial belt.
excerpt: Precision hyperlocal media in Pune's Bhosari industrial belt — delivering software messaging to decision-makers at their workplace.
content:
When Pune-based ERP company Solution One needed to deepen its footprint in the Bhosari industrial area, we provided a pin-code targeted media solution.

This data-driven approach ensured that every placement spoke to the right audience — decision-makers, factory owners, and tech partners within a precise geographic belt.
